placeholder.numbering: per message, occurrence-based: the source-context message numbers protected literals document-wide in reading order; every unit request numbers only that unit's literals, starting from 0
protected_runs: inline code runs with non-empty text
link runs whose visible text equals their own href (autolinks); ordinary links translate their display text and the href never enters the wire
placeholder.verification: slot-aware: every placeholder must survive exactly once, in the wire slot (sentence or table cell) it was protected from; any stray sentinel, non-canonical spelling (leading zeros, non-ASCII digit lookalikes, invented indices) is a protocol error
placeholder.restoration: single pass, full canonical spelling match; substituted text is never rescanned

request_sequence: system message: the exact text in system_prompt.txt
first user message: the code-free full-article source context (source-context schema)
one user message per translation unit, in article order; every request replays the system message, the source context and all previously accepted user/assistant turns in full
assistant history contains only the raw accepted content strings; reasoning content is never persisted

response_rules.sentence_unit: a bare JSON array of strings, exactly the same length as the request array, every item non-empty after trimming
response_rules.table_unit: the SAME JSON object shape: block_id, columns, alignments, header, rows; the same cell_id values in the same positions; every cell text non-empty; no added, dropped, merged or reordered cells/rows/columns
response_rules.fences: a leading BOM and at most one surrounding markdown code fence may be stripped before parsing; prose, object wrapping, wrong length, empty items, damaged placeholders or shape changes are protocol errors
response_rules.unit_kinds: sentence batches (one text block's sentences) and whole tables; code blocks, dividers and narration never produce units

context_rules.code_blocks: appear only as the content-free marker {"type": "omitted_code_block"}; code bodies, languages and hashes never enter any request
context_rules.tables: all visible cells in reading order (header first, then rows)
